abstract: We present 8 years' experience of primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RLND) in 190 patients with low stage non-seminoma; 154 patients had clinical stage I (CSI) and 36 had clinical stage IIa (CSIIa) disease. Of the 154 patients with CSI tumours, 33 had increased serum AFP and/or HCG before RLND (CSIM+) and 121 had normal tumour markers (CSIM-). Retroperitoneal lymph node metastases (pathological stage II) (PSII) were found in 38 of 121 patients with CSIM-, in 19 of 33 patients with CSIIM+ and in 26 of 36 patients with CSIIa. In a multivariate analysis, the presence of small vessel infiltration (demonstrated in histological sections of the primary tumour) and a prolonged tumour marker half-life were predictive factors for PSII. These 2 factors enabled a group of non-seminoma patients with CSI disease to be identified who had a 15% risk of retroperitoneal tumour growth (low risk group) as compared with a high risk group where 60 to 70% of patients had retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Relapses occurred in 7 of 107 patients with PSI and in 6 of 83 patients with PSII disease; in the latter group, 5 relapses developed before the start of routine adjuvant chemotherapy; 6% of patients developed major post-operative complications. In addition, "dry ejaculation" was the principal side effect following RLND (unilateral RLND: 20/132 patients; bilateral RLND: 50/54 patients). The comparative cost to the health service during the first year of follow-up was estimated for low risk non-seminoma patients with CSI subjected to RLND and for those in whom a surveillance policy was adopted. The latter approach was preferable. It was concluded that a surveillance policy should be followed in low risk non-seminoma CSI patients provided that frequent follow-up is possible. A more active policy is recommended in high risk patients (e.g. adjuvant chemotherapy without RLND). Nerve-sparing RLND may be considered in patients with CSIIa disease and negative tumour markers.
abstract_ja: 低病期の非セミノーマ性精巣がん190例に対する初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RLND）の8年間の経験を報告する。154例が臨床病期I（CSI）、36例が臨床病期IIa（CSIIa）であった。臨床病期Iの154例のうち33例は術前に血清αフェトプロテイン（AFP）および/またはヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン（hCG）が上昇しており（CSIM+）、121例は腫瘍マーカーが正常であった（CSIM-）。後腹膜リンパ節転移（病理学的病期II（PSII））は、CSIM-の121例中38例、CSIM+の33例中19例、CSIIaの36例中26例に認めた。多変量解析では、原発腫瘍の組織切片で示された小血管浸潤と、腫瘍マーカーの半減期延長がPSIIの予測因子であった。これら2因子により、後腹膜腫瘍の増殖リスクが約15%と低い群を同定できた。一方、高リスク群では60〜70%の患者に後腹膜リンパ節転移を認めた。再発はPSI 107例中7例、PSII 83例中6例に生じた。後者の群では、5例の再発が定型的な補助化学療法の開始前に生じた。患者の6%に重篤な術後合併症が生じた。RLND後の主な副作用は「ドライ射精」であった（片側RLND：132例中20例、両側RLND：54例中50例）。RLND後1年目のフォローアップにかかる医療費を、低リスクの臨床病期I非セミノーマ症例でRLNDを行った場合と監視療法を行った場合で比較した。その結果、頻繁なフォローアップが可能であれば、低リスクの臨床病期I非セミノーマ症例には監視療法を行うべきであると結論した。高リスク症例（例：RLNDを行わない補助化学療法）では、より積極的な方針が推奨される。腫瘍マーカーが陰性の臨床病期IIa症例では、神経温存RLNDを検討してもよい。
